note: Guest reviews as published on Airbnb (English text as shown there). Add or remove freely; 'apt' is left or right, 'month' is YYYY-MM.

reviews.name: James
reviews.text: Great apartment. Lovely location. Close enough to make everything walkable but also allow you to feel you are living amongst the locals. The living space has been well designed with lots of effort and touches included. Everything works. Fast WiFi. Modern appliances. Owners are superb. Always available to help and answer questions. Next time I come back I'll not even look at alternatives if I can get booked here.

reviews.name: Melina
reviews.text: Everything was just great! The place was super clean, cozy and equipped with really everything you could wish for – and even much more! There were so many thoughtful little touches that made the stay special: delicious coffee and cookies, a beach ball game, and many other things. It was especially sweet that she even left honey outside our door. 🍯 You could really tell how much love and effort went into the place.

reviews.name: Tina
reviews.text: Our stay here was great. The home is so beautifully decorated, very clean and spacious. Our hosts were also amazing – they left water, homemade cookies, coffee, a beach umbrella and detergent for laundry. The location is about a 15 minute walking distance to the port and the old town. It’s in a more local area and close to a number of supermarkets. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Luna
reviews.text: The accommodation was exactly as described, was clean and had everything we could need. Our hosts left us bottles of water, coffee, tea, and hygiene products for our arrival. The city center and port are within easy walking distance. Eirini and Stefanos are incredibly kind, give recommendations for places to go, and are responsive when we need them. ☀️

reviews.name: Alexandra
reviews.text: If you come across my review while looking for a place to stay, don't hesitate: book it! We absolutely loved our stay. The apartment is really great: clean, functional, beautifully decorated and, above all, you immediately feel good there. The hosts are lovely, available and responsive. A place to book without so much as a second thought.

reviews.name: Kurt
reviews.text: Place was beautiful, pictures do not do it justice. Very walkable to old town and the port. Great shower. Felt right at home. Highly recommend staying here. Great host. Thanks!

reviews.name: Ying Xuan
reviews.text: One of the best Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in! The hosts went above and beyond – welcoming us with delicious homemade snacks and even stocking the fridge with drinks. The place was spotless and exactly as described in the listing. On top of that, the location is fantastic – just a short walk to the city center. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Angélique
reviews.text: Very nice stay. Very good hosting from our hosts. Close to shops and the bus station, which makes all trips in the city and outside easy. Hosts who readily offer us advice and are very warm. Functional accommodation, very clean, with everything you need to feel at home. We would highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Lukas
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing hosts and a perfectly equipped apartment. The place has everything you need, from snacks to washing machine. Eirini and Stefanos were the most lovely people we met on our entire trip. Location is super close to the port and to the bus station, so arrival is made extremely easy. Will try to come again!

reviews.name: Lauri
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay in Heraklion so much. The accommodation was everything we were looking for. Had everything we needed and more. Super friendly hosts who always answered if we had questions. Totally recommend staying at their place. Thank you so much for your hospitality.

reviews.name: Larissa
reviews.text: Very clean and lovingly furnished apartment. Kitchen and bathroom were super furnished. Eirini & Stefanos are very nice and helpful hosts and there is a folder with many tips for the area. The area is quiet, and there are nice taverns and supermarkets nearby.

reviews.name: Elisabetta
reviews.text: Excellent, clean accommodation, equipped with everything you need for a stay of a few days. Convenient location to reach the city center even on foot. The property is very nice and cozy. I highly recommend it.

reviews.name: John
reviews.text: Eirini & Stefanos were excellent hosts, they offered to pick us up at the bus station at our arrival, the place was filled with thoughtful touches and great taste! Very convenient location near the bus station and ferry. They saved our last day by recommending a local beach and even showed us how to get there!

reviews.name: Αλέξανδρος
reviews.text: We are very happy with our stay! They took care of everything! A very beautiful, clean, and comfortable home in a quiet neighborhood! I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Emily
reviews.text: Highly recommend this apartment! Eirini and Stefanos were lovely hosts, they were super helpful, gave us great recommendations for restaurants and coffee shops and kindly dropped us off at the port for an early morning ferry. The apartment is awesome, very cool, modern and clean, in a convenient location.

reviews.name: Marius
reviews.text: The accommodation and communication were perfect. Very nice apartment, as shown in the pictures. Thank you for a great stay! 😁
